bylaw_name: Dog Licensing and Control By-law - PH-4
collar_tag_req: Owners are required to identify their domestic animals by animal identification systems including tagging, tattooing and microchip implantation.
dog_limit: No person shall keep or permit to be kept more than three dogs within or about any dwelling unit. Registered kennels under the Animal Pedigree Act are exempt.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw with no farm-friendly LGD provisions.

collar_tag_req: Every Person residing within the limits of the Municipality, who is the Owner of a Dog, shall cause the Dog to be Licenced.
dog_limit: No Person shall own, keep, possess or harbour more than three (3) Dogs at any one time, per dwelling unit, location or residence within the Municipality, with the exception of a licensed Kennel, an animal hospital/veterinary clinic, or a pet store.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw with no farm-friendly LGD provisions.

collar_tag_req: Dog Tag means the current Dog Tag provided by the License Issuer upon issuing a License for a Dog pursuant to this By-law, for attachment to the Dog identified in the License.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw with no farm-friendly LGD provisions.

collar_tag_req: Requires a 'Dog Identifier', meaning a physical tag attached to the Dog or Microchip bearing information that identifies the Owner of the Dog.
dog_limit: Urban area: 2 dogs. Rural areas: 5 dogs. Exemption: In a rural area, a person may Harbour more than five (5) Dogs on a property without a Kennel License, provided (a) the person is keeping Livestock upon the same property; (b) the property is zoned agricultural.
notes: Does not specifically define LGDs, but provides an exemption to the 5-dog limit in rural areas for properties keeping livestock on agricultural zoned land.

collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog shall keep the dog licence securely fixed on the dog at all times when the dog is not on the premises.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw with no farm-friendly LGD provisions.

collar_tag_req: Requires licensing and an animal identification system.
notes: The definition of 'Nuisance Animal', which covers excessive barking and howling, explicitly excludes animals kept or harboured on a farm.
